answer: Tie each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined per identity against an unpredictable per-epoch seed — a toll paid in real electricity, hard as ferrous ore. One honest agent completes a single voyage and mines once; a farmer must forge a fresh jade-hard proof for every account, every epoch, with no way to copy the cost across clones. A thousand fakes owe a thousand proofs recurring, and the compute bill climbs until the farm founders under its own weight.
